d:
BJP MP Janardan Mishra, representing Rewa in Madhya Pradesh, has sparked a major controversy with his remarks about farmers.
Speaking at a Govardhan Puja event in Mauganj, Janardan Mishra claimed that farmers work for only three months a year and spend the remaining nine months playing cards, consuming gutka, drinking alcohol and smoking cannabis.
His statement triggered strong criticism from opposition parties and farmers' organisations, with demands for a public apology and action against the BJP MP.
